title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for the Department' s review and approval an agreement for quasi-firm transportation service with Polariod Corporation.
filings: The Department notes that pricing under the QF Agreement exceeds the Company's marginal cost of providing the service, and therefore, the Agreement is hereby Approved. The Department also finds that information regarding the pricing terms and minimum quantity of therms to be purchased underthe Agreement is competitively sensititive and therefore, Grants the Company's request pursuant to G.L. C. 25 § 5D for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Dierdre K. Manning. (GC 00-16)
